# Relay draft wire fixtures

`wire.json` is copied without changes from Quick Presenter Relay, commit
`dec25702bd403bde25b572980854e36c2ba58c6e`, `protocol/fixtures/wire.json`.
It is licensed under Apache-2.0; the original LICENSE and NOTICE are retained here.

qp tests the incoming presenter messages and the reaction/comment payload subset.
Other fixture types belong to relay APIs or outgoing client messages and are not
claims of full runtime conformance. Update this snapshot deliberately when the
draft contract changes.
